senses.gloss: The diphthong Au or Ou, having the same sound as in Our, and considered as the fourteenth vowel of the Nāgarī alphabet.

ind.
An interjection of,
1 Calling, (ho! hola.)
2 Of addressing, (the vocative particle oh.)
3 A particle of prohibition, and
4 Of asseveration.

m. (-औः)
The serpent ANANTA.
f. (-औः)
The earth.

ind.
The mystical prefix proper for Śūdras: see ओम्.
